_comment: Spike loop: Pip drops onto a strip of spikes and pops, again and again. Keys starting with _ are comments; the runner ignores them.
_stage: A capture-only stage in The Drip's look (not the chapter 2 trench), so it is declared in capture_only.
_events: Every life drops from 150 px above the spikes (the stage's own spawn is 260), so the drop fits the short 16:9 frame too.
_pre_roll: Seconds of game time before frame 1, so Pip is already falling on frame 1.
_camera: Static framing. subject_width: Pip is 17.5% of the frame width in every output; each output size frames itself (a minimum view would go on an output as outputs[].view).

capture_only.why: spikeloop is a capture-only stage in The Drip's look, not a level from the game
next life after 0.65 s instead of 1.1 s, for a snappy rhythm
lives start 150 px above the spikes instead of the stage's 260, so the drop fits a 16:9 frame
the spike strip is a gentle tent so droplets slide off the sides (they keep their real lifetime)

outputs._view: The POP! word floats up about 200 px; a 16:9 frame at Pip's 17.5% is only ~206 px tall, so this output opts into a 330 px height floor (Pip is ~12% of its width).
